caption: The drawing displays three views of a rectangular wooden box with a hinged door and a metal handle. The largest illustration is of the box in perspective, showing the front, top, and side. The front panel of the box is metallic with the embossed inscription "Don’t burn your shaffs" and is attached to the wooden frame by a hinge, with a small ring handle on the left. The box corners are reinforced with four rounded wooden vertical supports. The side panel is also metallic with a punched-out decorative pattern of radiating dots and lines. The top contains three open slots separated by wooden dividers, and it has a metal carrying handle attached to opposite corners. Below this main image, there is a simple line drawing of the box from a rear angle showing the plain back and the lock mechanism. Next to it, a colored top view of the box reveals two more lines of embossed text on an interior metallic surface, reading “Piler aunts hats are ur shaffs from old sets,” and shows two internal wooden shelves. The color palette consists primarily of brown wood tones and silvery metallic grays, with texture details indicated by shading and line work. The background is a neutral cream color, and the entire drawing is executed with precise, realistic rendering.
title: Foot Warmer
